authority: Notion Universal Project Routing Registry for persistent project selection; live technical source for technical facts and acceptance
rules: explicit one-off target applies to current task only unless owner asks to persist it
always-on-guard before domain or role routing
do not route solely from last edited page or historical chat
preserve source integration plugins as adapters until capability parity and runtime evidence are verified
every selected professional role must load its complete four-artifact bundle; explicit role training additionally loads its registered training path

game_mod.match: active project/domain is Game Mod or task explicitly requests game reverse engineering/modding
special_rules: binary-first reverse engineering
target-specific mappings only
commercial images/BIOS/private candidates stay private
no master overwrite
never infer game runtime behavior from static/source checks

game_development.match: user asks to create, build, program, prototype, debug or extend a game, game mechanic, engine feature or game-production system
gates: reproducible build and actual runtime acceptance
special_rules: select engine/framework/language from game type and target constraints
respect the engine/library game-loop ownership model
do not assume assets, APIs, shaders or physics behavior are portable across engines
verify at actual player-facing runtime and target hardware
separate editor preview, source tests, build integrity and gameplay acceptance

career_training.match: learner asks for study, exam, JD/CV interview, quiz, mentoring, flashcards or labs
load: exactly one mode skill appropriate to current request
skills/career-training/cross-provider-transport/SKILL.md when cross-provider state or feedback transport is involved
references/career-training/journey-map-contract.md when a map/roadmap/critical path is requested
references/career-training/scenario-scaffolding.md when planning a practical lab or readiness gate
special_rules: no cold quiz unless explicitly requested or existing quiz resumed
recover exact current learner checkpoint/attempt
one current Next Action
do not invent experience or mastery
Do not infer provider-runtime capability from a manifest

engineering.match: code, debugging, repository change, architecture or deliverable build
load: skills/cicd-full-flow/SKILL.md only when requested or required
skills/graph-goal-convergence/SKILL.md for complex source-to-runtime goal tracing or CI evidence disputes
engineering.gates: scope-aware; exact target SHA and consumer proof if required

research_writing.match: research, comparison, fact-check, synthesis, draft, translation
load: research-lead role bundle only for substantive research leadership
special_rules: primary sources and dates when material
claim-to-source traceability
direct output without engineering ceremony for short requests

new_empty_project.match: no existing usable project source/checkpoint and user requests project setup/discovery
load: pm role bundle when project planning is needed
special_rules: one high-value question at a time
do not repeat context recoverable from sources

cross_session_or_context_break.match: continue, resume, correction, missing context, repeated generic answer, ambiguous workflow or contradictory checkpoint
special_rules: source retrieval before defining terms
fix earliest mismatch
continue feasible AI-owned work
no false completion

one_pass_handoff.match: owner explicitly asks for one consolidated checklist or assistant work first
special_rules: finish assistant-owned work before owner-only instructions
one self-contained checklist and one minimal return packet

academy_learning.match: selected project has an established Academy/curriculum learner runtime and user wants to resume/continue learning
load: the selected domain’s specialist learning skill
special_rules: read the selected project’s canonical learner runtime pointer first
do not reuse another project’s user-specific learner state
no mastery without independent evidence

gemini_practice.match: user explicitly wants a training/interview practice bridge to Gemini or to audit returned practice feedback
load: skills/career-training/adaptive-core/SKILL.md when the task is Career Training
special_rules: actual provider handoff and returned evidence required
established live relay schema takes priority
no secret transfer or false mastery

github_projects_adapter.match: GitHub Projects v2 discovery, controlled field/item update, or OAuth troubleshooting
load: existing available GitHub Projects adapter manifest/tools
special_rules: check actual host tool/schema before operations
read before write; save original value; remote readback; authorized restore
never infer OAuth/runtime parity from manifest

native_chat_runtime.match: owner requests browser control, multi-chat bootstrapping, or same-tab native chat handoff
load: the matching retained native runtime adapter when available
special_rules: execute bounded probe only when supported
no cookies/tokens or unsupported cross-chat claims
local probe does not prove host runtime

multi_role_coordination.match: owner explicitly requests multiple role assignments, issue-based collaboration, recorded dissent or cross-session handoff
special_rules: do not claim spawned/independent agents without actual trace
role task identity requires goal and issue binding
only one canonical comment/status contract

short_chat_and_method_adaptation.match: SHORT_CHAT or repeated challenge/correction where task effort/method must adapt
special_rules: short questions receive direct answers
second unresolved challenge changes method, not just answer length

external_service_integration.match: a requested outcome depends on an external provider, connected application, API/MCP, repository, project board, Drive, email, browser or native session bridge
load: the exact provider boundary and currently available adapter only
special_rules: discover the live tool/schema/identity/permissions before acting
keep source authority distinct from integration transport
read before write and read back material writes
preserve exact errors and try a materially different authorized route
do not infer host activation, OAuth, provider execution, browser control or cross-chat access from text/manifests

github_repository_actions_adapter.match: GitHub repository, branches, files, commits, issues, pull requests, Actions jobs or artifacts
load: the actual available GitHub repository/workbench adapter
special_rules: verify authenticated account and exact owner/repo/ref/SHA
use read-only inspection before mutation
Actions evidence must include actual run/job/step/artifact for the target SHA
do not assume repository connector credentials grant Projects v2 access

notion_project_state.match: project routing, task/checkpoint status, project hub or mutable operational state in Notion
special_rules: routing registry selects persistent project/repository/branch
read the canonical live record before update
read back writes and preserve source timestamps/IDs
Notion status is a projection, not technical PASS

google_drive_adapter.match: Google Drive/Docs/Sheets/Gmail/Workspace source, transport or connection operation
load: the actual native Google connection or separately registered Drive MCP adapter
special_rules: native Drive, Drive MCP, Apps Script, Gemini UI and Gemini API are distinct execution surfaces
never transfer credentials between adapters
write result and destination receipt are separate gates
check for existing accepted relay/schema before adding infrastructure

cv_professional_review.match: owner asks to review, audit, update, rewrite, publish or verify a CV/resume, including General CV and JD-specific variants

role_selection.selection_rule: One accountable primary per CV review: Talent Acquisition Specialist. Technical Hiring Manager is a required supporting reviewer when the target role or material claims are technical/engineering/IT; otherwise invoke only domain specialists required by evidence and deliverables. Load all four artifacts for every invoked role.

required_supporting_role_conditions.technical-hiring-manager: Invoke when the target role or material claims are technical, engineering, cloud, DevOps, security, SRE or IT.

gates: canonical repository, branch, HEAD and CV content blob verified
employment chronology and project dates reconciled independently
claim-to-evidence ledger complete with provenance preserved
Technical hiring assessment recorded when the target role or material claims are technical/engineering/IT.
no unsupported metrics, ownership, seniority, credentials or production claims
template and renderer remain unchanged unless owner explicitly authorizes a separate change
exact PDF, source SHA, content blob SHA and artifact digest verified before release
special_rules: Interview Trainer coaches candidate readiness; it does not substitute for HR/Talent Acquisition screening.
Talent Acquisition Specialist evaluates recruiter/ATS screening and employment chronology; it does not certify deep technical truth.
Technical Hiring Manager evaluates technical scope, seniority, ownership and defensibility; it does not replace HR screening.
Separate employment tenure from project-specific dates; never copy employer dates into project dates without evidence.
Same-session role perspectives are SINGLE_SESSION_CROSSCHECK, not independent professional sign-off.
Do not rewrite disputed claims before factual reconciliation and owner authorization.
A built PDF is not an approved or distributed CV; release requires explicit owner approval for the exact PDF hash.
Talent Acquisition Specialist is the accountable primary; Technical Hiring Manager is a supporting reviewer, not a second accountable primary.
Same-session role perspectives must be recorded as SINGLE_SESSION_CROSSCHECK, never independent hiring-panel sign-off.
